_comment: The Colosseum CLI build this repository measures with. `revision` records where
the binary came from; `sha256` is the executable hash that tools/setup_tools.ps1
and every wrapper run actually enforce, because a revision cannot be read back
out of a stripped executable. The released 0.1.0 reports the same version string
as the local build that preceded it, so the hash is the only identity that
out of a stripped executable. 0.2.0 reports its own version string, but the hash
`archive` is the published asset: `sha256` there is the digest GitHub serves for
the asset itself (this release has no SHA256SUMS file), checked on download,
while the top-level `sha256` is checked on the extracted executable. Re-pinning
to a later release is an edit to this file and to nothing else in the tree.
